name: core-trade-active
description: Rules audit (core, switch TI4_TRADE_RULES, on by default; =off restores trading off-turn): LRR 94 - during the action phase the active player transacts with each neighbour once per turn; other players do not transact with each other. The original accepted any transaction between neighbours at any time. Base: pbd1204 undo save 109 (action phase, Mentak active): Arborec, Bastion and Mentak each get a destroyer at Mecatol Rex (neighbours); Arborec's offer to Bastion (neither active) is refused, Mentak's (active) offer to Arborec goes out (trade.propose / sendOffer_ / acceptOffer_ / trade.offer validate: TradeRules).
